links.outcome: Accuracy of confidence-based triage separating high-confidence samples from those routed to expert review
links.effect: 62.2% of samples assigned to the high-confidence zone at 96.2% accuracy; external high-zone accuracy was 98.8%; lower-confidence cases routed to expert review.
links.quote: The confidence triaging system assigned 62.2% of samples to a high-confidence zone at 96.2% accuracy.

links.outcome: Calibration and conformal prediction coverage of model uncertainty estimates
links.effect: Conformal prediction achieved 95.9% empirical coverage; probability calibration used with confidence-based triaging.

links.outcome: Performance drop on independent external samples with frozen weights versus internal performance
links.effect: External validation accuracy was 0.871 versus internal 0.872; tuning-free cascade out-of-fold accuracy 0.866, indicating negligible hyperparameter overfitting.

unlisted_practices: Hierarchical cascade classifier design outperforming flat baselines
Automated reflex test recommendations and per-sample explainability in laboratory CDS

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a clinical decision support framework evaluating specific deployment safeguards including conformal prediction and confidence-based triaging to route uncertain cases to expert human review.
